blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Ethereum block 25534825 and Fluent block 10309817, the EIP-1967 implementation slots resolve to the independently verified JMIExtension implementations 0x1028a0e146d2915c509c8e019e0e5c66d3d22ae0 and 0x18091d82d55f68205f7f829acadb7897a7cb7d9c. Both verified implementations expose FREEZE_MANAGER_ROLE, freeze(address), freezeAccounts(address[]), unfreeze, unfreezeAccounts, and pause controls. Role-event histories show FREEZE_MANAGER_ROLE was transferred from the deployment account to 0x169A3703D64a100897C0E208a3Dcad86F3F6eC29; pinned hasRole reads for that account return true on both deployments. Therefore an active privileged authority can directly freeze arbitrary holder accounts across every tracked USDnr deployment.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USDnr has one native issuance deployment on Ethereum; Fluent is an M0 spoke representation. M0 HubPortal/SpokePortal and Hyperlane adapter machinery lock and account for the hub principal, then burn and mint spoke $M before local USDnr wrapping, so the route is issuer-native lock/mint rather than an independent Fluent liability. Portal, adapter, Fluent representation, SwapFacility, Mailbox, and ISM administrators are scored here, while Ethereum M issuance and wrapper upgrade risk remain in Mint Authority.

protocols.name: M0 Portal V2 / Hyperlane
protocols.note: Ethereum is the M0 hub and Fluent is a spoke; HubPortal/SpokePortal use Hyperlane adapters and route-level principal accounting.

routes.protocol: Nerona USDnr (M0 extension and HubPortal route)
routes.reviewNote: Canonical home deployment: USDnr is an M0 extension on Ethereum backed by the M0 MinterGateway rail. The HubPortal is also the canonical-side lock/release and principal-accounting rail for the Fluent route; at Ethereum block 25770356, bridgedPrincipal(25363) was 1,987,695,152,499 base units (1,987,695.152499 M). The token proxy's EIP-1967 admin is Nerona's ProxyAdmin 0x9ffe615c92635e5b36de004dd78a94c51aa04256, whose owner is the single EOA 0xc07f0b4556e0cc1bfd8a076a98d43e79acd3cd33; those native wrapper facts remain in Mint Authority.

Fluent is an M0 spoke representation, not an independent native USDnr liability chain. At Fluent block 13144952, SpokePortal currentChainId() was 25363 and hubChainId() was 1; its default adapter for Ethereum was 0xfcc1d596ad6cab0b5394eaa447d8626813180f32 and supportedBridgingPath(USDnr, 1, USDnr) was true. The spoke burn/mint path first moves local $M through the Portal and then wraps it into USDnr through the local SwapFacility; route-level conservation is bounded by the Ethereum HubPortal principal accounting.

controls.label: USDnr Fluent SwapFacility ProxyAdmin Safe
controls.capDescription: The Fluent SwapFacility wraps local spoke $M into USDnr and unwraps it on redemption; the route-level bridge bound is the Ethereum HubPortal bridgedPrincipal, while a ProxyAdmin upgrade could change the representation transfer rail.

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: The local SwapFacility wrap/unwrap path is 1:1 against Fluent $M; it does not independently create base M supply, and route conservation is tied to HubPortal principal accounting.
